algolia.name: Panasonic - DMC-FZ1000 20.1-Megapixel Digital Camera - Black
algolia.description: With a 25-400mm LEICA DC lens and 20.1-megapixel MOS sensor, this Panasonic DMC-FZ1000 digital camera allows you to capture high-resolution images and 4K QFHD videos simultaneously. Built-in Wi-Fi allows you to share stored files across devices.  Memory card sold separately.
